sloka: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शोकाविष्टो अंगदो अब्रवीत् ।पितुः समीपम् आगम्य सौमित्रिः अयम् आगतः ॥४-३१-३५॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā śokāviṣṭo aṁgado abravīt ।pituḥ samīpam āgamya saumitriḥ ayam āgataḥ ॥4-31-35॥

translations.english: On hearing Lakshmana's words Angada became sad. He approached his father (Sugriva) and said 'Saumitri has come'. (This sloka appears an interpolation).
